novel_features.name: Citation checker
novel_features.description: Check every Italian law citation in a draft or an AI answer: does it exist, and was it in force on a given date?
novel_features.rationale: Extracts citations with deterministic patterns, resolves aliases like c.c. or GDPR, and classifies each against point-in-time Normattiva text.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this before trusting any generated legal citation; non-zero exit means at least one citation is wrong or no longer in force.

novel_features.name: Article diff between dates
novel_features.description: See word by word what an article said on one date versus another, or versus its original text.
novel_features.rationale: Combines two multivigente fetches into a rendered diff with both vigenza windows, caching versions locally.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use it when the applicable version of a norm depends on the date of the facts (tempus regit actum).

novel_features.name: Watchlist change report
novel_features.description: Follow the acts you care about (segui add) and get a report of which ones and which articles changed since your last check.
novel_features.rationale: Joins the national updated-acts feed against a local watchlist and stored article snapshots.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use it for recurring compliance monitoring instead of scanning the whole national updates feed.

novel_features.name: Context pack
novel_features.description: Assemble several articles from different laws, all pinned to one reference date, into one Markdown document.
novel_features.rationale: Resolves many citations, fetches each at the same vigenza date, and composes one LLM-ready document with permalinks.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use it to give an agent or a filing the exact text of every relevant norm as of one date.

narrative.headline: Italian law in your terminal: resolve citations, read any article at any date, diff versions and track amendments.
narrative.value_prop: Type citations the way lawyers write them ("art. 2043 c.c.", "d.lgs. 196/2003 art. 13") and get the authoritative Normattiva text as clean text (or Markdown with --formato markdown), at today's date or any past date. On top of search and reading: verifica checks citations in a draft, diff shows how an article changed, novita reports changes to the acts you follow with segui add, and fascicolo builds date-pinned context packs for filings and AI agents.
narrative.auth_narrative: No account or API key needed: the Normattiva Open Data API is public. Be gentle with it — the CLI caches article text locally and paces its requests. Every result carries a permanent link on www.normattiva.it (https://www.normattiva.it/uri-res/N2Ls?<URN>).

quickstart.comment: Check the CLI is installed and configured, without touching the network
List well-known acts you can call by name, like the codice civile
Read one article as clean text
Check a citation was in force on a date

troubleshoots.fix: Wait a minute and retry; the Normattiva gateway drops bursts. Cached reads keep working offline.

troubleshoots.symptom: Atto non trovato for a URN
troubleshoots.fix: Read it from its Gazzetta coordinates (codice_redazionale and data_gu are in every search result): normattiva-pp-cli testo --codice 090G0294 --data-gu 1990-08-18

troubleshoots.symptom: periodo di esportazione superiore a 12 mesi (code 1501)
troubleshoots.fix: Use a shorter window, e.g. normattiva-pp-cli aggiornati --since 90d.

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI when an agent or a person needs the authoritative text of Italian national legislation (laws, decrees, codes, the Constitution), possibly as in force on a specific date, or needs to check that cited norms exist and are current. It is the right tool for citation verification, point-in-time reading, article diffs and amendment monitoring.
anti_triggers: Case law and court rulings (use a giurisprudenza tool such as giustizia-amministrativa)
Regional laws and EU regulations, which are outside Normattiva's State-law corpus
Legal advice or interpretation: the CLI returns text, not opinions

recipes.title: Verify citations in an AI answer
recipes.explanation: Extracts every citation, resolves it and exits non-zero if any is missing or no longer in force.

recipes.title: What changed in an article
recipes.explanation: Word-level diff between two point-in-time versions, with both vigenza windows.

recipes.title: Lean search results for agents
recipes.explanation: Search responses carry long titles and facets; select only the fields you need.

recipes.title: Weekly compliance check
recipes.explanation: After adding acts with segui add "d.lgs. 231/2001" --articoli 5,6, reports which followed acts and articles changed since the last check.

recipes.title: Bulk export, gated
recipes.explanation: Prints the export request only; add --avvia to queue it on Normattiva and --attendi --output file.zip to download. scarica likewise downloads only with --output.
